title: Ashen Oath: The Road Between Crowns
premise: Stay with the living when their safety depends on a lie about the dead.

chapters.title: Road of Crows
chapters.question: Why were the travelers carrying erased names?
chapters.summary: Bram, Sella, and Oren carried recovered tokens from recent road repairs. Their belongings drew Ghoulkin; a living hand tried to erase the aftermath.
chapters.stakes: Bring an honest account back to people who loved them. Decide who can safeguard the evidence.

chapters.title: Bell Beneath Greyfen
chapters.question: What did the shrine keep hidden?
chapters.summary: Disturbed graves and the sealed chapel expose burial rites that separated names from memory. Anwen admits the danger she contained by hiding the account.
chapters.stakes: Release, redirect, or temporarily contain memory without pretending silence is a cure.

chapters.title: Teeth in the Rain
chapters.question: Why is the binding failing now?
chapters.summary: Oren restored a name under the paint of an older token. The hidden road could not keep that memory disordered. Failed containment drew creatures and Vargan's recovery patrol.
chapters.stakes: Protect the living while deciding what happens to an intimate memory fragment.

chapters.title: The Names They Burned
chapters.question: Who may share a family's story?
chapters.summary: The register joins the tokens to a promise of sanctuary. Rook protects family addresses while Edric announces grain conditional on a renewed covenant.
chapters.stakes: Make wrongdoing known without turning vulnerable families into targets.

chapters.title: Ash at the Mill
chapters.question: What does restitution cost people who need food now?
chapters.summary: Greyfen ground refugee ash into its fields. The mill still supplies households that did not choose its founding crime. Copies of the ledger survive every operational choice.
chapters.stakes: Choose closure, supervised supply, or clean repair and restitution.

chapters.title: A Soldier Without a Banner
chapters.question: Can testimony establish responsibility without purchasing absolution?
chapters.summary: Senn admits closing the war road after Halvern refused. His present raids make historical injury a continuing excuse.
chapters.stakes: Preserve the account while deciding custody, exile, or execution.

chapters.title: Blood Under Stone
chapters.question: What makes Edric's emergency plan another concealment?
chapters.summary: The command ledger proves sanctuary and closure. Edric admits six years of suppression and proposes ration-backed assent to hide the road again.
chapters.stakes: Challenge his power, seek voluntary cooperation, or compel evidence without calling it consent.

chapters.title: The Last Witness
chapters.question: What could obedience have refused?
chapters.summary: Halvern holds a bounded memory of the sanctuary order, refusal, and execution. Kael admits that he abandoned a different escort and never went back.
chapters.stakes: Keep guaranteed command proof and accept responsibility for the people still on the road.

chapters.title: Crowns Without Mercy
chapters.question: Can people speak freely while protection depends on agreement?
chapters.summary: At the assembly the grain list is separated from assent. The unstable renewal is stopped, and records are distinguished from voluntary promises.
chapters.stakes: Aid and safe departure must remain available to households that refuse.

chapters.title: The Hart Remembers
chapters.question: What work begins when the Hart's burden ends?
chapters.summary: The complete witness remembers the gate, hidden road, and soldiers as distinct decisions. Kael can preserve an account; he cannot promise for Greyfen.
chapters.stakes: Choose public witness, private release, voluntary stewardship, or destruction with understood costs.

evidence.title: Bram stayed with the cart
evidence.text: Bram's marked tool and the repair traces place him at the damaged axle. He did not simply abandon the wagon.

evidence.title: The shrine thread
evidence.text: Sella's feathers carry thread Anwen identifies as hers. The shrine attempted containment before the attack.

evidence.title: Paint over an older name
evidence.text: Oren's painted crow covers an older name token. Its scratch marks follow restoration rather than random damage.

evidence.title: A second containment
evidence.text: Vargan binding wire is wrapped around the token. It links the aftermath to a recovery patrol, not proof that Edric ordered the original attack.

evidence.title: Belongings before food
evidence.text: Drag marks leave food sacks and follow identity-bearing objects. The creatures gathered testimony.

evidence.title: Harl's road mud
evidence.text: Road mud lies inside Harl's disturbed grave. The bell carries a gate memory rather than an intact returned husband.

evidence.title: Thread under the earth
evidence.text: The unnamed grave has shrine thread tied from within. Burial rites were keeping memory disordered.

evidence.title: A Vargan buckle
evidence.text: The empty soldier's grave holds Vargan work. A limited watch fragment can carry a fact without becoming a consenting living witness.

evidence.title: Why this road failed now
evidence.text: Recent repairs uncovered tokens. A restored name strained concealment, failed shrine containment left memory loose, and Vargan tried to reclaim the objects.
evidence.source: Anwen, Mira, and the restored token

evidence.title: Grain beside assent
evidence.text: Edric's current order places grain allotments beside household assent. A ration condition cannot create a freely witnessed oath.

evidence.title: Useful ash and stolen weight
evidence.text: The mill's weights match the missing refugee wagons. Its channels still support innocent households; the account survives decisions about continued operation.

evidence.title: The officer who closed the road
evidence.text: Senn says he closed the military retreat after Halvern refused. The admission establishes his role without excusing present raids.

evidence.title: Sanctuary followed by closure
evidence.text: The command and register establish sanctuary promised under a Vargan seal, Greyfen's closed gate, shrine concealment, and the military order.
evidence.source: Copied command ledger and bounded refusal

evidence.title: A different road
evidence.text: Kael admits obeying a retreat that abandoned civilians he had promised to escort. He left his failure out of the report and never went back.

evidence.title: Help without a signature
evidence.text: The ration condition is removed at the assembly. Household refusal no longer forfeits food or a safe way out.

outcomes.label: Close the tainted channels. Preserve the ledger and ration reserves.
outcomes.cost: The ledger is kept. The mill closes while relief grain is divided; workers lose shifts and the village must carry sacks from the reserve.
outcomes.result: The ledger is kept. The mill closes while relief grain is divided; workers lose shifts and the village must carry sacks from the reserve.

outcomes.label: Keep supervised milling. Replace the contaminated working copy.
outcomes.cost: The ruined working sheet is burned after a signed copy is kept. Supervised milling supplies flour while separate clean channels are prepared.
outcomes.result: The ruined working sheet is burned after a signed copy is kept. Supervised milling supplies flour while separate clean channels are prepared.

outcomes.label: Post the accounts. Begin clean repairs and pay for restitution.
outcomes.cost: The accounts are copied publicly. Workers begin replacing the channels; the first clean flour goes to affected households.
outcomes.result: The accounts are copied publicly. Workers begin replacing the channels; the first clean flour goes to affected households.

outcomes.label: Publish the recovered names and order. Remove family addresses.
outcomes.cost: The dead are named publicly and Edric's order is challenged. Family addresses stay off the board; fear and solidarity both follow.
outcomes.result: The dead are named publicly and Edric's order is challenged. Family addresses stay off the board; fear and solidarity both follow.

outcomes.label: Keep protected copies until the assembly. Tell each affected household.
outcomes.cost: Anwen and Rook keep separate copies. Affected households are warned privately before the assembly; the delay leaves the public order unchallenged for now.
outcomes.result: Anwen and Rook keep separate copies. Affected households are warned privately before the assembly; the delay leaves the public order unchallenged for now.

outcomes.label: Protect his hearing, not his title. Ask him to stop the renewal.
outcomes.cost: Edric voluntarily agrees to testify and release the grain without household signatures. His title and accounts pass to the public hearing.
outcomes.result: Edric voluntarily agrees to testify and release the grain without household signatures. His title and accounts pass to the public hearing.

outcomes.label: Make the ledger public. Remove his power to require signatures.
outcomes.cost: The ledger is exposed and the seal challenged. Edric refuses a personal oath; the proof is sufficient without pretending he agrees.
outcomes.result: The ledger is exposed and the seal challenged. Edric refuses a personal oath; the proof is sufficient without pretending he agrees.

outcomes.label: Compel his admission. Use the ledger as evidence, not his oath.
outcomes.cost: Edric admits his concealment under pressure. His words establish facts; the new covenant must use someone else's freely given responsibility.
outcomes.result: Edric admits his concealment under pressure. His words establish facts; the new covenant must use someone else's freely given responsibility.

outcomes.label: Clean the rite. Accept the danger shifting to the wood.
outcomes.cost: The chapel quiets. Anwen records that the debt was redirected, not erased, and goes to name the graves.
outcomes.result: The chapel quiets. Anwen records that the debt was redirected, not erased, and goes to name the graves.

outcomes.label: Open the memory. Keep the gathered names intact.
outcomes.cost: The erased names surface at the shrine. The village hears the bell; the recovered fragments are kept intact.
outcomes.result: The erased names surface at the shrine. The village hears the bell; the recovered fragments are kept intact.

outcomes.label: Hold the seal for now. Mark its limits in the record.
outcomes.cost: The seal holds temporarily. Kael marks its weakness instead of calling the silence a cure.
outcomes.result: The seal holds temporarily. Kael marks its weakness instead of calling the silence a cure.

outcomes.label: Destroy the memory core
outcomes.cost: The vessel collapses; its memory disperses into the wet ground. Mira keeps ordinary medicine available and prepares the refined oil.
outcomes.result: The vessel collapses; its memory disperses into the wet ground. Mira keeps ordinary medicine available and prepares the refined oil.

outcomes.label: Preserve it for study
outcomes.cost: Mira wraps the fragment and limits her study to what is already exposed. The future treatment must respect family consent.
outcomes.result: Mira wraps the fragment and limits her study to what is already exposed. The future treatment must respect family consent.

outcomes.label: Return it to Oren's grave
outcomes.cost: The fragment is settled beneath Oren's named marker. Its dangerous shape ends without opening its intimate memory to the village.
outcomes.result: The fragment is settled beneath Oren's named marker. Its dangerous shape ends without opening its intimate memory to the village.

outcomes.label: Accept surrender under custody. Ask for freely given testimony.
outcomes.cost: Senn lays down his sword and signs his own account. Custody remains; his oath to speak is voluntary.
outcomes.result: Senn lays down his sword and signs his own account. Custody remains; his oath to speak is voluntary.

outcomes.label: Take the written account. Disarm the camp and permit exile.
outcomes.cost: Senn leaves the confession and stolen supplies. He goes without offering a living oath.
outcomes.result: Senn leaves the confession and stolen supplies. He goes without offering a living oath.

outcomes.label: Execute Senn for the road killings. Keep the documented account.
outcomes.cost: Senn dies. The camp's signed account survives; no dead man is counted as a consenting living witness.
outcomes.result: Senn dies. The camp's signed account survives; no dead man is counted as a consenting living witness.

outcomes.label: Release the grain. Invite only those who choose to speak.
outcomes.cost: The ration condition is struck out. Willing witnesses speak; anyone who refuses can receive food and leave. Kael keeps the remaining record.
outcomes.result: The ration condition is struck out. Willing witnesses speak; anyone who refuses can receive food and leave. Kael keeps the remaining record.

outcomes.label: Break the ration condition. Carry the account yourself.
outcomes.cost: Kael removes the renewal seal and reads the copied account. No household is pledged by being present. He accepts the work of preserving what he read.
outcomes.result: Kael removes the renewal seal and reads the copied account. No household is pledged by being present. He accepts the work of preserving what he read.

outcomes.label: Break the condition and make Edric answer from the ledger.
outcomes.cost: The coercive renewal is stopped. Edric's compelled admission is entered as evidence; it is not counted as consent to the replacement covenant.
outcomes.result: The coercive renewal is stopped. Edric's compelled admission is entered as evidence; it is not counted as consent to the replacement covenant.

outcomes.label: Keep treating quietly until there is an alternative.
outcomes.cost: Mira keeps the ash bed open. The fever falls, but families cannot choose a treatment whose origin remains hidden.
outcomes.result: Mira keeps the ash bed open. The fever falls, but families cannot choose a treatment whose origin remains hidden.

outcomes.label: Explain the source. Offer each family another treatment.
outcomes.cost: Mira labels the ash draught and sets clean-root doses beside it. The treatment is slower for those who refuse, and care continues. Mira freely agrees to explain her own actions at the assembly.
outcomes.result: Mira labels the ash draught and sets clean-root doses beside it. The treatment is slower for those who refuse, and care continues. Mira freely agrees to explain her own actions at the assembly.

outcomes.label: Close the ash bed. Use clean roots and accept the delay.
outcomes.cost: Mira closes the old bed and prepares clean roots. Toma stays through the slower treatment; nobody calls the extra waiting harmless. Mira freely agrees to explain her own actions at the assembly.
outcomes.result: Mira closes the old bed and prepares clean roots. Toma stays through the slower treatment; nobody calls the extra waiting harmless. Mira freely agrees to explain her own actions at the assembly.

outcomes.label: Replace the useful iron gradually. Make named memorial work.
outcomes.cost: Tor begins replacement before dismantling working objects. Memorial nails carry the recovered names; his forge remains open.
outcomes.result: Tor begins replacement before dismantling working objects. Memorial nails carry the recovered names; his forge remains open.

outcomes.label: Keep the tools in use. Disclose their source and fund replacement.
outcomes.cost: Tor leaves the marks visible and posts the source above his prices. The useful stock stays in working hands.
outcomes.result: Tor leaves the marks visible and posts the source above his prices. The useful stock stays in working hands.

outcomes.label: Surrender the marked stock. Let the families decide its use.
outcomes.cost: Tor hands over the stock and his account. He keeps the forge running on ordinary scrap while the disputed iron stays intact.
outcomes.result: Tor hands over the stock and his account. He keeps the forge running on ordinary scrap while the disputed iron stays intact.

outcomes.label: Copy the route. Keep the families' homes private.
outcomes.cost: Rook marks a usable road without family addresses. He agrees to speak to the route under protection.
outcomes.result: Rook marks a usable road without family addresses. He agrees to speak to the route under protection.

outcomes.label: Destroy the map. Keep the route between us.
outcomes.cost: The paper burns. The road remains in Rook's memory, but no stranger can follow a copy now.
outcomes.result: The paper burns. The road remains in Rook's memory, but no stranger can follow a copy now.

outcomes.label: Publish the marked map so everyone can challenge Vargan.
outcomes.cost: The route becomes public evidence. Rook takes his bedding from the window; he did not consent to exposing his family.
outcomes.result: The route becomes public evidence. Rook takes his bedding from the window; he did not consent to exposing his family.

outcomes.label: Give Elna the whole account, and let her decide to speak.
outcomes.cost: Elna names his kindness and the people he shut outside. She chooses to give the assembly what she knows.
outcomes.result: Elna names his kindness and the people he shut outside. She chooses to give the assembly what she knows.

outcomes.label: Offer the gentler account. Leave the evidence with her.
outcomes.cost: Elna receives the bell and the written record. She declines a public account; the act itself stays documented.
outcomes.result: Elna receives the bell and the written record. She declines a public account; the act itself stays documented.

outcomes.label: Tell her everything privately. Keep her grief out of the square.
outcomes.cost: Elna accepts Harl's record for the family. His act remains evidence; her grief is not pledged to the assembly.
outcomes.result: Elna accepts Harl's record for the family. His act remains evidence; her grief is not pledged to the assembly.

outcomes.label: Move its protection path beyond the farms. Warn the neighbors.
outcomes.cost: Toma marks the outer boundary and moves the feeding place. The guardian survives beyond the fields; its danger is acknowledged.
outcomes.result: Toma marks the outer boundary and moves the feeding place. The guardian survives beyond the fields; its danger is acknowledged.

outcomes.label: Keep it at the fold under a disclosed village watch.
outcomes.cost: Toma tells the neighbors and organizes a watch. Protection remains, but the village can withdraw its agreement.
outcomes.result: Toma tells the neighbors and organizes a watch. Protection remains, but the village can withdraw its agreement.

outcomes.label: End the dangerous guardian. Record why it protected her.
outcomes.cost: The protection fragment is put to rest. Toma names the people it saved and the livestock his secrecy cost.
outcomes.result: The protection fragment is put to rest. Toma names the people it saved and the livestock his secrecy cost.

endings.title: Witness
endings.intention: Make the account public and remain responsible for keeping it.
endings.benefit: The dead receive public recognition; the Hart leaves judgment to living people.
endings.cost: Greyfen loses shelter for old privileges. Restitution and safe trade take labor; without allies Kael must remain to preserve the record.
endings.procedure: Publicly present the account. Voluntary witnesses share the work; records do not consent.

endings.title: Mercy
endings.intention: Release the Hart while safeguarding intimate memories and vulnerable family identities.
endings.benefit: The Hart's captivity ends without forcing private grief into every household.
endings.cost: A smaller circle must preserve complete copies. Public acknowledgment is partial, and future neglect can leave grievances unresolved.
endings.procedure: The Hart accepts a safeguarded account and an uncoerced keeper. Proven institutional wrongdoing stays on record.

endings.title: Duty
endings.intention: Freely carry the unresolved binding without pledging anyone else.
endings.benefit: Greyfen gains immediate stability and time for repairs; the record survives openly.
endings.cost: Kael's freedom and rest become limited. He carries continuing memory while restitution remains unfinished.
endings.procedure: Defend a containment rite and accept stewardship voluntarily. Support shares practical work, never another person's consent.

endings.title: Ash
endings.intention: Destroy the supernatural witness while preserving recovered human proof.
endings.benefit: The Hart's immediate pressure ends; people can rebuild without its demand.
endings.cost: The complete account is lost forever. Dispersed memory harms land and future harvests; copies cannot recover every missing name.
endings.procedure: Fight the Hart Avatar. Destruction is force, not a consensual replacement oath; human accountability may continue.

consent_rules: A document establishes facts and cannot promise for its owner.
Protected voluntary testimony remains voluntary only while food and safe departure do not depend on assent.
Compelled admissions may support the record, never a magical covenant.
Kael can pledge his own future work; he cannot bind Greyfen by being its hunter.
